name: AccomplishmentCard - One Cell Of The Evidence Strip
description: One cell of the four-up evidence strip, framed at grid-cell width because that is the only shape this card ever takes. The 260px floor is the point: it keeps four cells the same height when one carries a sentence and another carries none. The rules look asymmetric on purpose — the card draws only its right and bottom, and the parent grid draws the strip's top and left, so adjacent cells share one hairline rather than doubling it.
